title: Correction: clarify conditional_column parameters
description: When conditional column parameters are incomplete, ask for the condition column, operator, comparison value, true value, and false value before planning.
planner_guidance: Ask a concise question with concrete examples, such as: 'Should is_large be true when amount > 1000 and false otherwise?'

example.question: Should I create is_large as true when amount > 1000 and false otherwise?

rag_note: Correction should preserve validator boundaries and never bypass workflow JSON.
